confirm.title: Connect Pi Wake & Sleep to Assist
confirm.description: Add native tools to your existing AI conversation agent. Start with status questions. To request changes or cancel a countdown, enable change requests in Pi Wake & Sleep → Assist. Calendar dates, wake tests, and reboots require approval in the app. Select Assist under Control Home Assistant in your conversation agent's settings.

error.cannot_connect: The app could not be reached. Start Pi Wake & Sleep, enable Assist, and try again.

abort.already_configured: Pi Wake & Sleep is already connected.
abort.invalid_discovery: Reconnect Assist from the Pi Wake & Sleep app. This discovered connection could not be verified.
abort.use_discovery: Open Pi Wake & Sleep → Assist and select Connect Assist. Restart Home Assistant if requested, then add the discovered integration here. No address or API token is needed.

homeassistant_restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish Pi Wake & Sleep setup
homeassistant_restart_required.description:
The Pi Wake & Sleep dashboard companion was installed or updated. Open [Settings](/config), select the menu (⋮), then **Restart Home Assistant**. Only Home Assistant needs to restart for this step.

After it returns, finish Pi Wake & Sleep in **Devices & services** if requested and refresh your browser. This reminder clears when the updated companion connects and the dashboard is ready.
